_about: Human-reviewed corrections for Bible in a Year episode → Scripture mappings. Each override replaces the feed-derived passages for a Day (all years) or for one episode id. Passage ids are anchor ids (Clementine Vulgate numbering), e.g. "PSA.18" for modern Psalm 19. Add reviewedBy and reviewedOn to every entry.
